title: Summary Writing Techniques
intro: Summary Writing in descriptive examinations requires condensing the overarching substance of an argumentative, narrative, or informational text into approximately one-third of its volume while retaining its key assertions, main conclusions, and overall tone without needing an explicit title.
bengali: Summary Writing (সারমর্ম লিখন): Précis Writing-এর সাথে এর মূল পার্থক্য হলো Précis-এ কঠোরভাবে শব্দসংখ্যা গণনা ও Title দেওয়া বাধ্যতামূলক, যেখানে Summary-তে মূল ভাবের প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক সংক্ষিপ্তসার নিজের ভাষায় তুলে ধরাই প্রধান উদ্দেশ্য।

rules.rule: THE CORE ARGUMENT EXTRACTION: Identify the primary thesis sentence of each paragraph and synthesize them into a continuous, logical narrative.
examples: Underline the single most important thematic sentence from each paragraph.
Synthesize these core points using cohesive sentence linkers (Furthermore, Consequently, Therefore).
exceptions: Do not include supporting data, footnotes, or peripheral digressions in a summary.

rules.rule: OBJECTIVE REPHRASING IN OWN VOCABULARY: Paraphrase the author's ideas using fresh vocabulary without introducing extraneous personal viewpoints.
examples: Source: 'The relentless felling of ancient timber stands has unleashed cataclysmic erosion along the riverbanks.'
Summary: 'Deforestation has accelerated severe soil erosion along rivers.'
exceptions: Essential technical terms or proper nouns (names of treaties, places) may be retained intact.

rules.rule: CONCISENESS AND ECONOMY: Replace lengthy dependent clauses with compact prepositional phrases or single precise adjectives.
examples: Source: 'A person who is incapable of making mistakes' -> Summary: 'An infallible person.'
Source: 'At that point in time when the clock struck twelve' -> Summary: 'At noon.'
exceptions: Ensure clarity is not sacrificed for extreme brevity.

commonMistakes: Quoting lines verbatim directly from the original passage.
Inserting personal commentary or moral advice not present in the original text.
Writing a summary that is nearly as long as the original passage.
Focusing on minor illustrative anecdotes instead of the overarching argument.
examTricks: The Clause-to-Phrase Condensation: Compress subordinate clauses into gerunds or participial phrases to cut word count by 40%.
The Topic Sentence Formula: The first and last sentences of each paragraph provide 80% of your summary material.
One-third Target: Aim for roughly 30-35% of the original passage length.
memoryTricks: EXTRACT the marrow, discard the bone.
revision: No personal opinions or external additions.
Maintain logical flow with linkers (However, Therefore).
